lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cs2MgAu crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing eight atoms and three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all three elements adopt body-centered-cubic-like local arrangements: Au and Mg centers each have eight Cs neighbors, while Cs centers have four Au and four Mg neighbors, all at 3.8024 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all eight sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations indicate that Cs–Cs 8-vertex polyhedra share corners, edges, and faces, while Au–Mg polyhedra share corners and edges.
